zh.name: 真人穿搭与上脚展示
zh.summary: 把鞋放进整套穿搭，并展示上脚细节。
zh.useWhen: 适合运动鞋、靴子等需要配合全身穿搭展示的鞋款。
zh.instructions: 上传全身穿搭照和上脚近景，填写卖点。
zh.output: 上脚效果和鞋履搭配图。

en.name: Complete Outfit and On-foot Views
en.summary: Turn your product photos into a TikTok Shop carousel about complete Outfit and On-foot Views.
en.useWhen: For sneakers and boots that are easier to picture in a full outfit.
en.instructions: Upload product and reference photos, then add verified details.
en.output: An editable TikTok Shop carousel with complete Outfit and On-foot Views.
